task: Write load_config(path) that reads a JSON config file and returns the settings dict, falling back to the built-in defaults when the file is unreadable or malformed.

constraints.text: except clauses name concrete exception types; the bare except: form is gone from this repo
constraints.why: a bare except in the 2025-08 loader ate KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit, turning failed deploys into zombie processes

constraints.text: handlers catch FileNotFoundError, OSError and json.JSONDecodeError individually rather than Exception
constraints.why: catching Exception hid a TypeError for three releases in 2025-10; the service silently ran on default settings in prod

constraints.text: every fallback to defaults emits a log line carrying the underlying error
constraints.why: the 2026-02 rate-limit outage ran for four hours on default settings before anyone realized the config had failed to parse; nothing was logged

checks.description: failure swallowed silently (pass or bare return {})
